objects=[]
for i,s in enumerate(lines):
 if s.strip()=='{':
  try:x,_=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode('\n'.join(lines[i:]))

  objects.append((i+1,x))

assert source['input_count']==1096 and source['inputs']==review['complete_inputs']
assert final['observer']['source_commit']==G

 inv=review['actual_input_mode_blob_inventory'][p];assert v['git_blob']==inv['sha'] and v['git_mode']==inv['mode'] and v['sha256']==inv['sha256']
builds=[x for _,x in objects if 'build_exit_code' in x];assert len(builds)==1 and builds[0]['build_exit_code']==0
artifacts=[]
for name,v in final['artifacts'].items():
 a=v['cargo_artifact'];assert a['fresh'] is False and a['profile']['opt_level']=='3' and a['profile']['debug_assertions'] is False
 assert v['binary_sha256']==v['copy_source']['sha256'] and v['binary_bytes']==v['copy_source']['bytes']
 artifacts.append({'name':name,'binary_sha256':v['binary_sha256'],'binary_bytes':v['binary_bytes'],'compiler_fresh_field':a['fresh'],'profile':a['profile']})
assert builds[0]['binary_sha256']==report['product_sha256']==final['artifacts']['codecortex']['binary_sha256']
assert builds[0]['oracle_sha256']==report['oracle_sha256']==final['artifacts']['p8-oracle']['binary_sha256']
assert builds[0]['statistics_sha256']==final['artifacts']['p8-runtime-statistics']['binary_sha256']
verified=[]
for i,s in enumerate(lines):
 if s.startswith('{"status": "sealed_artifacts_verified"'):verified.append((i+1,json.loads(s)))
assert len(verified)==1 and verified[0][1]=={'status':'sealed_artifacts_verified','files':2111,'observation_status':'passed_observation','observation_exit_code':0}
controls=[]
for i,s in enumerate(lines):
 m=re.fullmatch(r'(test_\S+) \(([^)]+)\) \.\.\. ok',s)
 if m:controls.append({'line':i+1,'name':m[1],'qualified':m[2]})
assert len(controls)==77 and len({c['qualified'] for c in controls})==77
assert 'Ran 77 tests in 18.526s' in lines and 'OK' in lines
assert '--profile soak --concurrency 4 --operations 3601' in raw and '--files 1000 --interval-ms 1000' in raw
assert '##[error]' not in raw and 'Process completed with exit code' not in raw
assert 'Final size is 51072495 bytes. Artifact ID is 11655721056' in raw
assert '32734e2cf385dcc65e57317ca9988b1e8284f7d0565879efa467d01cfc066305' in raw

for r in snap['requests']:

assert all(c['status']=='completed' and c['head_sha']==G for c in checks['check_runs'])

assert all(s['conclusion']=='success' for s in job['steps'])
